newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan steel shares rise on hopes of leading market.
newsitem.headline: Japan steel shares rise on hopes of leading market.

text.p: The Japanese steel sector gained ground on Friday, supported by growing market hopes that steel firms' shares are likely to precede a recovery in the entire stock market, traders said.
The share price of Kawasaki Steel Corp gained four yen to 356 yen at 0330 GMT. Volume was 3.644 million shares, the second heaviest.
Nippon Steel Corp climbed to 350 yen before finishing the morning steady at 347 yen. Turnover hit 6.751 million, the heaviest in the market.
